note: After the original description by Holmgren (1913) (in German, placed in the subgenus Eutermes (Eutermes) as the fifth species). The alate is unknown and only the soldier and the two worker forms are described. The original is in German and was extracted by OCR from the Internet Archive scan; a few word forms and figures are misrecognized (e.g. l,i for 1,1) and have been checked against the context; measurements are in mm as in the original.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: (The original describes only the soldier; the alate is unknown.) Very close to E. ovipennis but slightly smaller, with a smaller head and a relatively longer nasus. Antennae 13-segmented. Anterior margin of the pronotum almost not concave. Hairs as in ovipennis.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head orange with a paler transverse band, the rest of the body straw-yellow, the gut contents showing through. Head broadly oval; head sutures distinct; fontanelle rather large; transverse band concave anteriorly; basal plate of the postclypeus very short and flat; antennae 13—14-segmented, segment 2 as long as segments 3+4. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin slightly concave. Small worker: head sutures and fontanelle indistinct; antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 almost equal to segments 3+4, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 4; anterior margin of the pronotum not concave.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm). Soldier: body length 3.5—4; head with nasus 1.50; head length without nasus 0.91; head width 0.99; pronotum width 0.40. Large worker: body length 5; head width 1.00; pronotum width 0.60. Small worker: body length 4; head width 0.84; pronotum width 0.46. Distribution: Borneo, Sarawak (Haviland).
